definition: The angle a rotating body turns through, $\Delta\theta = \theta_\text{f} - \theta_\text{i}$, measured in radians, with a sign that shows the sense of rotation (for example anticlockwise positive).
The rate of change of angular velocity, $\alpha = \frac{\Delta\omega}{\Delta t}$, measured in rad s⁻²; it is caused by a resultant torque.

A body's resistance to a change in its rotation about a given axis, $I = \sum mr^{2}$ with $r$ the perpendicular distance of each mass from the axis, so it depends on how the mass is spread about that axis; unit kg m².
